main.description: On the source host: start moving the group to another host. Answers with a service token signed by the group, for the destination's migrateReceive; the group's handle, address and spaces; and a token, good for an hour, with which the destination pulls the group from here (migrateExport). Requires group.configure.

snapshot.description: {handle, address, spaces: [uri]}: the group's handle and address, and every space the group holds, each by its URI, as a string. For migrateReceive, as it is.
